## Project details {.flow}

::: {.card title="Project overview"}
The goal is to understand patterns in student engagement at Collins College and explore how those patterns may relate to enrollment and retention. The final dashboard will summarize the results for college stakeholders in a clear and useful format.
:::

::: {.card title="Questions the dashboard should answer"}
- What forms of student engagement are available in the data?
- How should enrollment and retention be measured?
- Do engagement patterns differ across time or available student groups?
- What follow-up questions should stakeholders consider?
:::

## Planned views {.flow}

::: {.card title="Dashboard components"}
| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Summary measures | Show the main engagement and enrollment indicators |
| Trend chart | Compare patterns over time |
| Group comparison | Explore relevant student segments |
| Notes | Explain definitions and limitations |

The final version will use validated, de-identified data and will avoid treating associations as proof of causation.
:::
